issue: Does the Second Amendment, under Bruen, bar prosecuting a convicted felon under 18 U.S.C. § 922(g)(1) as applied to that defendant?

sides.position: Section 922(g)(1) is unconstitutional as applied to the particular defendant (a felon whose Second Amendment right is not properly disarmed).
cases: United States v. Range, 69 F.4th 96 (3d Cir. 2023)

sides.position: Section 922(g)(1) is constitutional as applied; there is no need for felony-by-felony litigation over its constitutionality.
cases: United States v. Jackson, 69 F.4th 495 (8th Cir. 2023)

quote: In fact, there is already a circuit split on the constitutionality of § 922(g)(1), the federal felon-in-possession statute.
cite: United States v. Daniels, 77 F.4th 337 (5th Cir. 2023)
